pythagoras_cubicle.name: Pythagoras / walls made of proofs
pythagoras_cubicle.description: Open-front 7 × 7 metre cubicle. Each of three walls pairs two square diagrams: c² and a²+b². Leg ratios 3:4, 2:5 and 1:6. The existing rearrangement geometry forms the wall surfaces. Swap animates the same triangles; reset restores the pairs. Displayed values are diagram units, not physical metres.

triangle_direction_sign.name: Pink triangle / four directions
triangle_direction_sign.description: A pink triangle on a one-metre round black plate with a metal post and weighted base. A hand/ray button turns only the symbol through up, right, down and left. Floor-origin prefab; front faces +Z.
interactions: Turn the triangle by a quarter turn

construction_triangle_brace.name: Temporary triangular steel bracing
construction_triangle_brace.description: Bolted chevron bay of I-section steel between columns. A reusable construction triangle; geometry and collision, without structural-load simulation.
construction_triangle_brace.qfep_connection: A triangle becomes part of the structure that holds a space open.

parameters.span: Width between inner column faces, metres
parameters.rise: Height above the lower chord, metres

pythagoras_floor.name: Pythagoras / the same four panels
pythagoras_floor.description: Seven-metre floor rearrangement proof. Four congruent right triangles translate inside the same square, leaving c² or a²+b². Compare 3/4 and 2/5 legs. Uses the existing hand/ray push buttons.
pythagoras_floor.qfep_connection: A change of arrangement preserves area: what changes and what remains are separately visible.
